label: Preset column widths
desc: Widths the column-width switch cycles through, as screen proportions, comma separated

label: Left strut
desc: Empty space niri keeps clear at the left screen edge, in pixels

label: Right strut
desc: Empty space niri keeps clear at the right screen edge, in pixels

label: Top strut
desc: Empty space niri keeps clear at the top screen edge, in pixels

label: Bottom strut
desc: Empty space niri keeps clear at the bottom screen edge, in pixels

label: Server-side window frames
desc: Ask apps to drop their own title bars so niri draws the frame

label: Overview zoom
desc: How far the overview pulls back, lower fits more workspaces on screen

label: Hot corners
desc: Push the pointer into a screen corner to open the overview

label: Skip hotkey overlay
desc: Don't show the keybind cheat sheet when the session starts

label: Screenshot path
desc: Where niri saves screenshots; date tokens like %Y %m %d expand to the moment it is taken
